scope.exhaustiveness: exact partial formal solving on completely constructed supported residual graphs; unsupported/truncated systems are retained without downstream profiles; geometric filters remain necessary-condition filters

placement_enumerator.description: Finite exhaustive enumeration of pole-image placements and contact-imposed parities.

positive_word_length_filter.description: Rejects a generated two-equation system when equality of word lengths has no solution with every formal variable assigned a strictly positive integer length.

formal_word_solver.description: Default exact-partial mode labels a case exact only after its complete residual graph is built. Finite and fixed-context power SCCs are compiled into complete finite/nested-power families; complete but morphic graphs and graph-budget truncations are retained without downstream profiles. Legacy bounded mode remains optional.

family_representative_expansion.description: Independent optional adapter for explicit minimum, fixed, or bounded-range exponent specialization. It is disabled by default; exact parametric families remain separate from primitive finite solutions.

curve_term_solver.description: Post-word-solver formal interpretation of terminal mappings. It emits explicit Straight(lambda), Mirror and Inverse curve terms and positive straight-length classes without modifying the generic word-equation solver.

formal_cycle_unroll_cap.description: Independent anti-echo policy. It prunes a branch after repeated returns to the same residual system, reports every hit as truncation, and does not recognize parametric families.

decorated_solution_canonicalization.description: Canonical key for the terminal contour together with both copy mappings, modulo pole exchange, curve/angle renaming, copy permutation, and global mirror. It annotates but does not delete profiles.

point_angle_solver.description: Exact signed angle classes and forced-zero point turns.

total_turn_filter.description: Exact necessary total-turn feasibility test in the symbolic model.

pole_angle_filter.description: Exact necessary simultaneous inequalities at P0 and P1. Retained as a cheap early filter; the authoritative downstream check combines both poles with inner and outer rotation equations.

joint_angle_feasibility.description: One exact rational linear program jointly enforces the inner and outer total turns, every angle-class bound, and both strict pole margins. A profile survives only when a strictly positive rational margin exists.

translation_holonomy_filter.description: Rejects only formally proved chord-closure contradictions; undecided systems are retained.

forced_point_coincidence.description: Integrated exact symbolic prefix-identity filter on the inner and outer boundaries. It rejects only forced unintended coincidences and remains incomplete for identities requiring nonlinear trigonometric consequences.

external_boundary_builder.description: Constructs the shared inner/outer boundary system, exact linear turn equations, and chord expressions used by independent downstream filters.

placed_copy_geometry.description: Places the reference tile and both copies in one symbolic frame using one global direct or reflected isometry per copy. It rejects forced self-coincidences and exact same-side arc overlaps; isolated extra cross-copy point contacts and generic curved crossings are deliberately not rejected.

curve_template_duality.description: Numeric compiler and validator for the formal curve-term solution. It propagates full edge-length and internal-turn templates under reversal/reflection and removes artificial vertices from Straight(lambda) values.

geometric_candidate_search.description: Differential evolution searches the reduced polygonal template model. Found contours satisfy local terminal curve-template duality and prototype simplicity, but full three-copy non-overlap is still not certified; failures remain inconclusive.

joint_translation_z3.description: Z3/NLSAT solves a polynomial relaxation augmented with pointwise equations from one global direct or reflected isometry for each copy. UNSAT is a safe rejection for the encoded model; SAT is only a candidate because generic curved-arc intersections, winding intervals, and complete three-interior disjointness are not encoded.

interpretation.exact_supported: The residual graph was completely constructed and every useful cycle was compiled into the supported finite/nested-power language.
interpretation.exact_unsupported_family_language: The complete residual graph is known, but at least one useful SCC mixes or branches evolving variables beyond the supported nested-power compiler.
interpretation.unresolved_graph_limit: Graph construction reached its node/edge budget; no completeness claim is made.
interpretation.expansion: Finite formal families are always sent downstream. Parametric families remain symbolic unless the explicit family expansion policy selects one or more exponent assignments.

pipeline_sequence: exact residual-graph solving with finite/nested-power family compilation
independent exponent specialization for the legacy downstream pipeline
formal Voderberg type classification and optional downstream selection
optional decorated-solution canonicalization including copy mappings
joint exact rational angle filter (inner, outer, and both poles)
forced point coincidence filter on inner/outer boundaries
shared-frame three-copy coincidence and same-side overlap filter
optional Z3/NLSAT polynomial filter with pointwise global-copy isometries

interpretation.z3_unsat: Exact for the polynomial relaxation and safe for rejection.
interpretation.z3_sat_or_timeout: Not a realizability proof; the profile remains a candidate.
interpretation.positive_length_filter: Exact necessary condition for nonempty word substitutions; it is independent of geometric arc length and rejects before bounded formal branching.
interpretation.voderberg_type_classifier: Formal contact-topology compatibility only; not a geometric realizability proof.
